categories.main_business_segments: Jiumaojiu International Holdings Limited operates primarily in the restaurant industry with multiple brands including Tai Er, Song Hot Pot, Jiu Mao Jiu, Fresh Wood, Shanwaimian, Lai Mei Li, and Uncle Chef. The business segments include restaurant operations, delivery services, sales of goods, and franchising/cooperative models. Tai Er is the largest revenue contributor, followed by Song Hot Pot and Jiu Mao Jiu, with other brands and sales to third parties also contributing to revenue.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes high-quality food preparation with a focus on core dishes and ingredient quality. It operates central kitchens and supply chain centers for ingredient processing and product production, including a new supply chain center in Guangzhou Nansha for primary processing and external sales. The Group uses digital and intelligent systems to optimize supply chain planning, inventory management, and restaurant operations, enhancing freshness, reducing waste, and improving management efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are consumers of Chinese cuisine dining services, including dine-in and delivery customers. The Group serves a broad market across multiple cities in China and international locations, targeting both local and overseas Chinese communities. The delivery business and franchising models also expand customer reach. The Group's brands cater to different dining preferences within the Chinese cuisine segment.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group operates extensively in mainland China across 141 cities and has expanded internationally with restaurants in Singapore, Canada (two cities), Malaysia, Thailand, the United States (two cities), and Indonesia. The headquarters and main supply chain centers are located in Guangzhou, China, with principal business presence also in Hong Kong.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiumaojiu operates primarily downstream as a restaurant operator and brand manager but also has upstream involvement through investments in associates engaged in fish and cattle farming and agricultural product processing to secure stable supply of key ingredients. The Group has established supply chain centers for ingredient processing and product manufacturing, supporting both internal restaurant needs and external sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group focuses on multi-brand and multi-concept expansion with prudent network growth, optimizing restaurant layouts, and enhancing core brand quality. It prioritizes digital and intelligent transformation to improve supply chain efficiency and restaurant management. The Group also emphasizes product quality, customer experience, and service excellence. Expansion into international markets with a focus on Chinese communities is a strategic priority. Supply chain development, including new processing centers and external sales channels, is a key R&D and operational focus.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through restaurant operations (dine-in services), delivery business, sales of goods to third parties, and franchising/cooperative management services. The Group also earns income from government grants and value-added tax incentives (now expired). Delivery and sales of goods have been growing segments, complementing traditional restaurant revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The Group positions itself as a leading Chinese cuisine restaurant brand manager and operator in China with a multi-brand strategy. It competes in a highly competitive catering market with intense competition affecting same-store sales and customer spending. The Group leverages brand diversification, supply chain integration, and digital transformation to maintain competitiveness. Specific competitors are not named in the report.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended 2024, the Group reported revenue of RMB6.07 billion, a slight increase of 1.5% from 2023. Profit for the year dropped significantly by 90.7% to RMB44.8 million due to various cost pressures and impairments. The Group operates 807 restaurants (779 self-operated and 28 franchised/cooperative) across multiple countries. Staff costs, depreciation, and other expenses increased, reflecting network expansion. The Group maintains a prudent financial policy with a gearing ratio of 12.0% and cash reserves of RMB607 million as of year-end 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The Group emphasizes providing customers with delicious, affordable, and safe dining experiences through high-quality core dishes, sincere service, and unique dining atmospheres. It differentiates by multi-brand and multi-concept strategies, digital and intelligent operational enhancements, and a robust supply chain ensuring ingredient quality and safety. The Group also focuses on optimizing restaurant layouts and upgrading restaurant models to meet evolving consumer needs, aiming for sustainable long-term growth and strong market positioning.
